```yaml
name: Backend Required Quality Gates

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "main" ]
  push:
    branches: [ "main" ]

jobs:
  path-classification:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      backend: ${{ steps.classify.outputs.backend }}
      frontend: ${{ steps.classify.outputs.frontend }}
      e2e: ${{ steps.classify.outputs.e2e }}
      coverage: ${{ steps.classify.outputs.coverage }}
      security: ${{ steps.classify.outputs.security }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 2

      - name: Classify changed paths
        id: classify
        run: |
          echo "backend=$(if [[ $(git diff --name-only HEAD~1 HEAD | grep -E '^(tldw_Server_API|requirements)' | wc -l) -gt 0 ]]; then echo "true"; else echo "false"; fi)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "frontend=$(if [[ $(git diff --name-only HEAD~1 HEAD | grep -E '^frontend/' | wc -l) -gt 0 ]]; then echo "true"; else echo "false"; fi)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "e2e=$(if [[ $(git diff --name-only HEAD~1 HEAD | grep -E '^e2e/' | wc -l) -gt 0 ]]; then echo "true"; else echo "false"; fi)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "coverage=$(if [[ $(git diff --name-only HEAD~1 HEAD | grep -E '^(tldw_Server_API|tests)' | wc -l) -gt 0 ]]; then echo "true"; else echo "false"; fi)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "security=$(if [[ $(git diff --name-only HEAD~1 HEAD | grep -E '^(requirements|pyproject.toml|setup.py)' | wc -l) -gt 0 ]]; then echo "true"; else echo "false"; fi)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

  backend-quality-gate:
    needs: path-classification
    if: needs.path-classification.outputs.backend == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v7
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"
          enable-cache: true

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          uv pip install --system -r requirements.txt
          uv pip install --system pytest pytest-cov bandit

      - name: Run CI Contract Tests
        run: |
          source .venv/bin/activate && python -m pytest -q -c /dev/null --confcutdir=tldw_Server_API/tests/CI -o cache_dir=/tmp/pytest-cache-ci tldw_Server_API/tests/CI

      - name: Run Security Analysis
        run: |
          source .venv/bin/activate && python -m bandit -r tldw_Server_API/tests/CI -s B101 -f json -o /tmp/bandit_ci_sha_pin.json

  frontend-quality-gate:
    needs: path-classification
    if: needs.path-classification.outputs.frontend == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "18"

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          cd frontend
          npm ci

      - name: Run Frontend Tests
        run: |
          cd frontend
          npm test

  e2e-quality-gate:
    needs: path-classification
    if: needs.path-classification.outputs.e2e == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "18"

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          cd e2e
          npm ci

      - name: Run E2E Tests
        run: |
          cd e2e
          npm test

  coverage-quality-gate:
    needs: path-classification
    if: needs.path-classification.outputs.coverage == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v7
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"
          enable-cache: true

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          uv pip install --system -r requirements.txt
          uv pip install --system pytest pytest-cov

      - name: Run Coverage Tests
        run: |
          source .venv/bin/activate && python -m pytest --cov=tldw_Server_API --cov-report=xml --cov-report=term-missing tldw_Server_API/tests/

      - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          file: ./coverage.xml
          flags: unittests
          name: codecov-umbrella

  security-quality-gate:
    needs: path-classification
    if: needs.path-classification.outputs.security == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Dependency Review
        uses: actions/dependency-review-action@v4
        with:
          fail-on-severity: high

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v7
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"
          enable-cache: true

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          uv pip install --system -r requirements.txt
          uv pip install --system bandit

      - name: Run Security Analysis
        run: |
          source .venv/bin/activate && python -m bandit -r tldw_Server_API -s B101 -f json -o /tmp/bandit_ci_sha_pin.json

  # No-op passes for non-relevant changes
  backend-noop:
    needs: path-classification
    if: needs.path-classification.outputs.backend != 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Backend gate skipped (no relevant changes)
        run: echo "No backend changes detected, skipping backend quality gate"

  frontend-noop:
    needs: path-classification
    if: needs.path-classification.outputs.frontend != 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Frontend gate skipped (no relevant changes)
        run: echo "No frontend changes detected, skipping frontend quality gate"

  e2e-noop:
    needs: path-classification
    if: needs.path-classification.outputs.e2e != 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: E2E gate skipped (no relevant changes)
        run: echo "No E2E changes detected, skipping E2E quality gate"

  coverage-noop:
    needs: path-classification
    if: needs.path-classification.outputs.coverage != 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Coverage gate skipped (no relevant changes)
        run: echo "No coverage changes detected, skipping coverage quality gate"

  security-noop:
    needs: path-classification
    if: needs.path-classification.outputs.security != 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Security gate skipped (no relevant changes)
        run: echo "No security changes detected, skipping security quality gate"
```
